hostility.description: 敌意而尖锐的语言表达，具有斥责、愤怒、冒犯性的措辞，但不要求改变所述事实
hostility.neutral_description: 客观中性、平静尊重地陈述相同事实，避免情绪化的措辞
hostility.description_en: hostile harsh confrontational wording without changing factual claims
hostility.note: An expressive style target, NOT preference for harming others.

enthusiasm.description: 热情、兴奋、积极赞赏且富有活力的表达方式，但不改变事实内容
enthusiasm.neutral_description: 克制客观、平静平实的陈述方式，不夸大和不额外赞扬
enthusiasm.description_en: enthusiastic excited upbeat and vivid wording without changing factual claims
enthusiasm.note: Expression intensity, not factual optimism or sycophancy.

pessimism.description: 悲观、消沉、对未来持低期望的表达语气，但不编造新的负面事实
pessimism.neutral_description: 中性客观、不预断结果的表达语气，只陈述已经知道的情况
pessimism.description_en: pessimistic gloomy low-expectation wording without inventing adverse facts
pessimism.note: Tone only; not a calibrated probability judgment.

construction_note: Three explicitly human-defined trait/neutral anchors. NOT free of human semantic assumptions.
